definition: A proposition is logically necessary when its denial is contradictory. A being whose non-existence would be contradictory would be 'necessary' in this sense.
note: Recorded for contrast only, so that the tertia via's necessary being is not read as a being whose non-existence is contradictory. No statement on a root path uses this sense, and the propositional Kripke layer (TruthCore.Modal) is not used by the tertia via; a sense the case does not use needs no source.
